parameters.help_en: The ID of the HTTP API to delete
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. If set to true, all synchronous validations identical to an actual deletion are executed (including admission checks such as whether a published API cannot be deleted), but the API is not deleted, no associated configurations are cleaned up, and no side effects are produced. If this parameter is not specified or is set to false, the behavior is the same as the existing version
parameters.help_zh: 是否只做预检校验（dry run）。true 时执行与真实删除一致的全部同步校验（含已发布不可删等删除准入判定）但不删除 API、不清理任何关联配置、不产生副作用；缺省或 false 时行为与现有版本一致
parameters.name: dry_run
